And all at once things seemed so small   My breath came short, and scarce at all. But, sure, the sky is big, I said;   Miles and miles above my head;   So here upon my back I'll lie   And look my fill into the sky.

arxiv-2111-03387.title: Electronic correlations and Fermi liquid behavior of intermediate-band states in titanium-doped silicon
arxiv-2111-03387.creator: A. Östlin, L. Chioncel
arxiv-2111-03387.description: Abstract We study the nature of the electronic states in the intermediate band formed by interstitial titanium in silicon. Our single-site description combines effects of electronic correlations, captured by dynamical mean-field theory, and disorder, modeled using the coherent potential approximation and the typical medium mean-field theory.

arxiv-2203-07536.title: Quantum Computation of Reactions on Surfaces Using Local Embedding
arxiv-2203-07536.creator: Tanvi P. Gujarati, Mario Motta, Triet Nguyen Friedhoff, Julia E. Rice, Nam Nguyen, Panagiotis Kl. Barkoutsos, Richard J. Thompson, Tyler Smith, Marna Kagele, Mark Brei, Barbara A. Jones, Kristen Williams
arxiv-2203-07536.description: Abstract Modeling electronic systems is an important application for quantum computers. In the context of materials science, an important open problem is the computational description of chemical reactions on surfaces. In this work, we outline a workflow to model the adsorption and reaction of molecules on surfaces using quantum computing algorithms.

arxiv-2206-02400.title: Isospectrum of non-self-adjoint almost-periodic Schrödinger operators
arxiv-2206-02400.creator: Xueyin Wang, Jiangong You, Qi Zhou
arxiv-2206-02400.description: Abstract . For non-self-adjoint almost-periodic Schrödinger operators, a criterion is given to guarantee that they have both the same spectrum and same Lyapunov exponents with the discrete free Laplacian. As a byproduct, we show that the Moser-Pöschel argument for opening gaps may not be valid for non-self-adjoint operators. 1.

arxiv-2206-03696.creator: QI-YANG ZHENG
arxiv-2206-03696.description: Abstract . In this paper we study b 5 ​ ( n ) b_{5}(n) , the 5 5 -regular partitions of n n . Using the theory of modular forms, we prove several theorems on the divisibility and distribution properties of b 5 ​ ( n ) b_{5}(n) modulo prime m ≥ 5 m\geq 5 .

arxiv-2210-07961.title: Computing efficiently the weighted greatest common divisor
arxiv-2210-07961.creator: Orgest Zaka
arxiv-2210-07961.description: Abstract . In this paper we included some basic properties for weighted greatest common divisors, and discuss how to speed up computing the weighted greatest common divisor. By ordering the ’weights’ we are able to significantly shorten the operations to computing wgcd \wgcd .

arxiv-2402-17813.title: String Shooter’s overall shape in ambient air
arxiv-2402-17813.creator: M. Abello, J. Courson, A. Maury, J. Renaud
arxiv-2402-17813.description: Abstract In this article, we study the behaviour of a looped string launched in ambient air using motorised wheels. We show that the loop, once it reaches its stationary state, is either in the pulley or the air-lifted state. The transition between these two distinct states occurs at the so-called takeoff speed .

arxiv-2408-05294.title: Quantum corrections to the orbital Hall effect
arxiv-2408-05294.creator: Hong Liu, James H. Cullen, Daniel P. Arovas, Dimitrie Culcer
arxiv-2408-05294.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hong Liu, James H. Cullen, Daniel P. Arovas, Dimitrie Culcer. Evaluations of the orbital Hall effect (OHE) have only retained inter-band matrix elements of the position operator. Here we evaluate the OHE including all matrix elements of the position operator, including the technically challenging intra-band elements. We recover previous results and find quantum corrections due to the non-commutativity of the position and velocity operators and inter-band matrix elements of the orbital angular momentum.

arxiv-2409-15441.title: Steward : Natural Language Web Automation
arxiv-2409-15441.creator: Brian Tang, Kang G. Shin
arxiv-2409-15441.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Brian Tang, Kang G. Shin. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in serving as the foundation for AI assistants. One emerging application of LLMs, navigating through websites and interacting with UI elements across various web pages, remains somewhat underexplored. We introduce Steward , a novel LLM-powered web automation tool designed to serve as a cost-effective, scalable, end-to-end solution for automating web interactions.

arxiv-2503-09599.title: Hints of Primordial Magnetic Fields at Recombination and Implications for the Hubble Tension
arxiv-2503-09599.creator: Karsten Jedamzik, Levon Pogosian, Tom Abel
arxiv-2503-09599.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Karsten Jedamzik, Levon Pogosian, Tom Abel. Primordial Magnetic Fields (PMFs), long studied as relics of the early Universe, accelerate recombination and have been proposed as a way to relieve the Hubble tension. However, previous studies relied on simplified toy models.

arxiv-2505-00675.title: Rethinking Memory in LLM based Agents: Representations, Operations, and Emerging Topics
arxiv-2505-00675.creator: YIMING DU, WENYU HUANG, DANNA ZHENG, ZHAOWEI WANG, Sebastien Montella, Mirella Lapata, Kam-Fai Wong, Jeff Z. Pan
arxiv-2505-00675.description: Abstract . Abstract: Memory is fundamental to large language model (LLM)-based agents, but existing surveys emphasize application-level use (e.g., personalized dialogue), while overlooking the atomic operations governing memory dynamics. This work categorizes memory into parametric (implicit in model weights) and contextual (explicit external data, structured/unstructured) forms, and defines six core operations: Consolidation, Updating, Indexing, Forgetting, Retrieval, and Condensation.

arxiv-2508-09398.title: Autonomous AI Bird Feeder for Backyard Biodiversity Monitoring
arxiv-2508-09398.creator: El Mustapha Mansouri
arxiv-2508-09398.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by El Mustapha Mansouri. This paper presents a low-cost, on-premise system for autonomous backyard bird monitoring in Belgian urban gardens. A motion-triggered IP camera uploads short clips via FTP to a local server, where frames are sampled and birds are localised with Detectron2 [ 1 ] ; cropped regions are then classified by an EfficientNet-B3 model [ 2 ] fine-tuned on a 40-species Belgian subset derived from a larger Kaggle corpus [ 3 ] .

pmc-10690852.title: An Undetected Pheochromocytoma Leading to Fulminant Adrenergic Myocarditis Complicated by Cardiogenic Shock
pmc-10690852.creator: Nam Q Tran, Hieu T N Tran, Thang V Tran, Thuan T Nguyen
pmc-10690852.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Pheochromocytomas are rare catecholamine-secreting neuroendocrine tumors. Their episodic nature is correlated with abrupt catecholamine release and clinical manifestations that mimic other vascular conditions, leading to delayed diagnosis and potentially life-threatening complications, such as acute myocarditis and pheochromocytoma crises. In this report, we described the case of fulminant adrenergic myocarditis-induced cardiogenic shock requiring extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support in a Vietnamese middle-aged man with a 5-year history of Brugada syndrome, hypertension, and previously undiagnosed pheochromocytoma.

pmc-11327250.title: Phase-stabilised self-injection-locked microcomb
pmc-11327250.creator: Thibault Wildi, Alexander E. Ulanov, Thibault Voumard, Bastian Ruhnke, Tobias Herr
pmc-11327250.description: Microresonator frequency combs (microcombs) hold great potential for precision metrology within a compact form factor, impacting a wide range of applications such as point-of-care diagnostics, environmental monitoring, time-keeping, navigation and astronomy. Through the principle of self-injection locking, electrically-driven chip-based microcombs with minimal complexity are now feasible.

pmc-11656392.creator: Yixuan Liu, Jilai Wu, Likai Zhou, Chao Wei, Hua Chen
pmc-11656392.description: HCl-catalyzed C-glycosylation was described herein for the convenient preparation of N-heteroaryl C-glycosides and polyhydroxylated alkanes with diaryl groups using hetereoaryl amines and unprotected sugars as starting materials. The reaction temperature and the amounts of aryl amines and HCl had significant effects on reactions. pmc-11710537.creator: Eun Hyun Seo, Hyung‐Jun Yoon, Seung Gon Kim, Kyu Yeong Choi, Jung‐Min Ha, Hoowon Kim, Kun Ho Lee
pmc-11710537.description: BackgroundRecent studies have shown that the Rey Complex Figure Test (RCFT) is useful for early detection of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). While RCFT is known as a test for visuoconstruction and memory, it demands executive components during copying and recalling of the complex figure.

pmc-12549831.title: Biological rhythm and depression severity mediate the relationship between adverse childhood experiences and non-suicidal self-injury among adolescents with depressive disorder
pmc-12549831.creator: Fengxiu Yang, Jianqun Fang, Jingru Liu, Guoxia Mu, Li Tan, Ru Ma, Yanrong Wang
pmc-12549831.description: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) is prevalent in adolescents with first-episode major depressive disorder (MDD). Adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) and biological rhythm disorder (BRD) have been recognized as risk factors for NSSI in patients with MDD. However, the mechanisms that lead to NSSI remain unclear.

pmc-12829719.title: EUS–guided liver biopsy: A useful and cost-effective alternative for specific indications in the study of liver diseases
pmc-12829719.creator: Teresa Alvarez-Nava, Carolina Ibarrola, Felipe de la Morena, José Díaz-Tasende, Yolanda Rodríguez-Gil, Carlos de la Serna, Cristina Martin-Arriscado, Ana Martín, Inmaculada Fernández, Ángel Sánchez, Mercedes Pérez-Carreras
pmc-12829719.description: Background and ObjectivesComparative studies have demonstrated that EUS–guided liver biopsy (EUS-LB) is a useful and safe technique. However, there is not sufficient evidence information on their cost differences and potential applications. We aimed to investigate whether EUS-LB is a cost-effective alternative to traditional LB methods (percutaneous [PC-LB], transjugular [TJ-LB]) and determine its indications in clinical practice.

pmc-13001183.title: Tracking androgens in female elite athletes: menstrual cycle and hormonal contraceptive effects
pmc-13001183.creator: Jana Nolte, Sven C Voss, Annekathrin Martina Keiler, Emily Büthe, Kirsten Legerlotz, Petra Platen
pmc-13001183.description: BackgroundUnderstanding variations in the androgen profile is crucial for interpreting hormone data and developing cycle-based training strategies tailored to individual athlete needs. Therefore, this study investigates the androgen concentrations of elite female track and field athletes across various hormonal conditions, including natural eumenorrheic cycles, cycles under hormonal contraception, and cycles with menstrual disturbances.
